mission_02: Excellent! You have implemented Variational Quantum Circuits, the workhorse of near-term quantum machine learning. Your VQC applies parameterized RY and RZ rotations interleaved with CNOT entangling gates, creating a rich, trainable quantum model. The parameter-shift rule provides exact gradients without backpropagation through the quantum circuit — each gradient component requires just two circuit evaluations at shifted parameters. This hybrid quantum-classical approach is how NISQ (Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum) devices are used for machine learning today: the quantum circuit prepares a complex quantum state, classical measurement extracts expectation values, and a classical optimizer updates the parameters. VQCs power quantum classifiers, quantum generative models, and variational quantum eigensolvers.
